name: Shoutou Coffee
source:
Mamekawa works as a server at a cafe. He's never talked to his classmate, Mutou, even though she's a regular customer.

One night, Mutou comes in with a man, as usual, but after a while, she's left alone.

Mamekawa notices this and strikes up a conversation...

[Translated from [url=https://nohana-no3.jimdofree.com/2020/02/12/original-game-消灯コーヒー]official website[/url]]
translation:
豆川在咖啡馆担任服务生。同班同学无糖虽然是店里的常客，两人却从未说过话。

某个夜晚，无糖像往常一样与一名男子来到店里，可没过多久，店里就只剩下她一个人。

注意到这一点的豆川，主动向她搭了话…

[译自[url=https://nohana-no3.jimdofree.com/2020/02/12/original-game-消灯コーヒー]官方网站[/url]]
